text: Hear the thunder call
Banners of a burning dawn
Squadrons of the brave fly on
Drums are rolling, spirits high
We were made to storm the sky
Louder than the storm we ride
Side by side, side by side
Storm the sky, we are the lightning
Hearts of steel, forever fighting
Rise as one, a wall of thunder
Tear the clouds and stars asunder
Storm the sky, storm the sky
Every wing a blazing blade
Every fear a debt repaid
Glory calls and we reply
We were made to storm the sky
Louder than the storm we ride
Side by side, side by side
Storm the sky, we are the lightning
Hearts of steel, forever fighting
Rise as one, a wall of thunder
Tear the clouds and stars asunder
Storm the sky, storm the sky
Storm the sky
